status_reviews.researcher_notes: Retired fits the old string that Gazprom moved to liquidate. Since 2022 occupation authorities have been restoring the corridor. Kommersant in July 2022 says gas already reaches Berdyansk. A Mariupol news item from September 2023 says the Mariupol gas station is fed from the Taganrog-Mariupol trunk. A 2025 occupation-authority order covers replacement of pipe on the same corridor, which is carried on rows P7817 and P7818. I cannot tell from documents whether the old row should be shown as under rebuild instead. The evidence covers the Ukrainian section only. Baird to rule. No change staged.
